result.topic_en: Draft on the representability of a function by its Fourier series via the Dirichlet integral, using two lemmas on the integral of sin((2n+1)β)/sin β, concluding that every periodic function that is integrable and has finitely many maxima and minima can be represented.

items.english: It would namely have to be shown that the finite [sum] ... the integral ... approaches the value fx indefinitely as n grows to infinity.
From this follows the representability of every periodic function which 1) admits integration throughout, 2) does not have infinitely many maxima and minima.
